title: bcl_convert
description:
Convert bcl files to fastq files using bcl-convert.
Information about upgrading from bcl2fastq via
https://emea.support.illumina.com/bulletins/2020/10/upgrading-from-bcl2fastq-to-bcl-convert.html
and https://support.illumina.com/sequencing/sequencing_software/bcl-convert/compatibility.html

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `bcl_dir`

sample_sheet.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `bcl_dir`

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `fastq_dir`

test_mode.description: Should bcl-convert be run in test mode (using --first-tile-only)?

strict_mode.description: Abort if any files are missing.

tiles.description: Process only a subset of tiles by a regular expression.

exclude_tiles.description: Exclude set of tiles by a regular expression

no_lane_splitting.description: Wheter to avoid splitting FASTQ file by lane.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
